name: product-lift-unit
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun test lean-kernel/lift/*.test.ts && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json

name: product-lift-alpha
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun lean-kernel/lift/smoke.ts lift-fixtures/lock_server alpha "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/alpha"

name: product-lift-counted
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun lean-kernel/lift/smoke.ts lift-fixtures/simple_election counted "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/counted"

name: product-lift-witness
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun lean-kernel/lift/smoke.ts lift-fixtures/simple witness "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/witness"
